text:
```artifact
@start
initial state: IDLE

mode TRIGGER_INSPIRATION:
  on event INSPIRATION_DETECTED:
    if pressure < -4cm:
      transition to INSPIRATION
    else:
      transition to IDLE

mode INSPIRATION:
  on event INSPIRATION_ENDED:
    transition to TRIGGER_EXPIRATION

mode TRIGGER_EXPIRATION:
  on event EXPIRATION_DETECTED:
    transition to EXPIRATION

mode EXPIRATION:
  on event EXPIRATION_ENDED:
    transition to TRIGGER_INSPIRATION

@end
```
